title: Could This BE Any More Wrong? Teaching VLMs to Know What They Don't Know in Document Extraction
abstract: arXiv:2611.30119v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-Language Models can extract structured fields from scanned financial documents, yet they provide no indication of when a field might be wrong. We derive per-field confidence estimates from the token log-probabilities the model already produces, via a token-to-span alignment procedure that maps logprobs onto each extracted value within the structured JSON output. Evaluated on two benchmarks (CORD v2 receipts, Kleister NDA legal contracts) with three VLM families, the minimum token probability per field achieves Area Under the ROC Curve (AUROC) 0.74-0.91 for error detection, far exceeding verbalized confidence (0.53-0.56). The uncertain fields form a natural training curriculum: fine-tuning via Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) improves accuracy from 78.5% to 87.5% on CORD (67 examples) and from 70.7% to 75.1% on multi-page NDA contracts (259 examples), while substantially improving error detection on Kleister NDA (AUROC 0.7

translated_title: 这还能更错吗？教会视觉语言模型在文档抽取中知道自己不知道什么
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型能够从扫描的金融文档中提取结构化字段，但它们无法提示某个字段何时可能是错误的。我们通过一个词元到片段的对齐程序，将模型已经生成的词元对数概率映射到结构化JSON输出中的每个提取值上，从而得出每个字段的置信度估计。在两个基准数据集（CORD v2收据、Kleister NDA法律合同）上对三个视觉语言模型家族进行评估，每字段的最小词元概率在错误检测上达到0.74-0.91的ROC曲线下面积（AUROC），远超语言化置信度（0.53-0.56）。这些不确定的字段构成了一个天然的训练课程：通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行微调，在CORD上将准确率从78.5%提升至87.5%（67个样本），在多页NDA合同上将准确率从70.7%提升至75.1%（259个样本），同时显著改善了Kleister NDA上的错误检测性能。
tldr: 该论文提出利用视觉语言模型自身产生的词元对数概率，通过对齐方法为文档抽取的每个字段生成置信度估计以实现错误检测，并将不确定字段作为训练课程，用GRPO微调同时提升抽取准确率和错误检测能力。
